desc:
Yo! Your pet buddy is waiting for you!
Defeat enemies and feed it fruit to help it grow. What will it grow into? It's seriously cute.

Head out on adventures together. Slime Island, dark caves, places no one has found yet. When a giant raid boss appears, team up with everyone on the server to take it on.

Craft furniture and decorate your home however you like. Visit your friends' homes, or throw a party and invite them over. What's not to Like? Dress your pet up in dozens of cute hats.

There are seasonal events going on, too!
